source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Rear Suspension and Drive Line, p.4-17

procedures.title: Rear wheel spindle and support: remove, repair and install
steps: Removal: take out the drive spindle as described under Wheel Bearing Adjustment.
Make bearing removers from 3/8" square steel bar (see figure 40 in the manual).

With the deflector, inner grease seal and inner bearing race off, the bearing cups can be driven out with the remover while the support is still on the torque arm; fit new cups with installer J-7817 and handle J-8092 (see figure 41 in the manual).
To take the support off the torque arm: disconnect the parking brake cable from the actuating lever.
Remove the 4 nuts holding the support to the torque arm; lift off the brake backing plate and move it aside.
Disconnect the shock absorber lower eye from the strut rod mounting shaft, supporting the outer end of the spring first if needed.
Remove the cotter pin and nut from the strut rod mounting shaft and pull the shaft out of the support and strut rod.
Remove the spindle support; service the cups as above.

To remove the spindle outer bearing and seal: place J-8331 between the chamfered edge of the bearing seat and the bearing inner race, clamp it in a vise and apply pressure to unseat the bearing (see figure 42 in the manual).
Put J-8331 and the spindle in an arbor press and press the bearing off (see figure 43 in the manual).
Remove the outer seal, check it and replace if damaged.
Pack the outer bearing with high-melting-point wheel bearing grease and place it on the spindle.
notes: The shock absorber has internal rebound control, which is why the spring end may need support before disconnecting it.
Caution: take great care placing J-8331 against the machined spindle surface; remove any nicks or burrs from the tool where it touches the spindle before pressing.
The outer seal must go on the spindle before the outer bearing inner race and rollers.
Figure 39 in the manual is a cross-section of the spindle, support, bearings, spacers, deflector and brake parts.
